title: Latent Nonlinear Denoising Score Matching for Enhanced Learning of Structured Distributions
abstract: arXiv:2512.06615v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Score-based generative models commonly employ linear forward diffusions with Gaussian reference distributions, limiting their ability to directly incorporate structural information into the noising dynamics. We introduce latent nonlinear denoising score matching (LNDSM), which combines nonlinear, structure-informed latent diffusions with the variational autoencoder (VAE) training framework. In our construction, the forward diffusion is designed to admit a prescribed reference distribution, such as a Gaussian mixture model, that reflects qualitative features of the latent data distribution. We derive a computable approximation to a cross-entropy upper bound in the VAE objective using Euler-Maruyama discretization and the resulting Gaussian conditional transitions. translated_title: 面向结构化分布增强学习的潜空间非线性去噪得分匹配
translated_abstract: 基于得分的生成模型通常采用带高斯参考分布的线性前向扩散，这限制了它们将结构信息直接融入加噪动力学的能力。我们提出了潜空间非线性去噪得分匹配（LNDSM），它将非线性的、结构感知的潜空间扩散与变分自编码器（VAE）训练框架相结合。在我们的构造中，前向扩散被设计为具有一个指定的参考分布（例如高斯混合模型），该参考分布能够反映潜空间数据分布的定性特征。我们利用 Euler-Maruyama 离散化以及由此得到的高斯条件转移，推导出 VAE 目标中交叉熵上界的一个可计算近似。为了稳定训练，我们去除了两个零均值控制变量，其方差在小时间步长下会变得很大。所得到的目标函数能够实现编码器（及其相关模块）的联合训练。
tldr: 本文提出潜空间非线性去噪得分匹配（LNDSM），通过将结构感知的非线性潜空间扩散与VAE训练框架结合，并指定能反映数据定性特征的参考分布（如高斯混合模型），从而将结构信息直接融入加噪动力学，增强对结构化分布的学习。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Latent Nonlinear Denoising Score Matching (LNDSM), which combines nonlinear, structure-informed latent diffusions with the VAE training framework by prescribing reference distributions (e.g., Gaussian mixtures) that directly incorporate structural information into the noising dynamics, thereby enhancing the learning of structured distributions.
